content_fields.title: Test for Server Side Request Forgery
content_fields.description: Validate the outbound request target against an allow-list and block requests to internal addresses.
content_fields.finding: requests.get is issued against an unvalidated caller-supplied URL, reaching internal addresses and non-HTTP schemes.
content_fields.current_code:
def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
criteria: Only HTTPS URLs on the allow-list are fetched.
Every resolved address is checked against private, loopback, link-local and reserved ranges.
Redirects are not followed, so the validated target is the one contacted.
